intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Compares any cursor string lexically against spaceRev, so a DID-shaped cursor sorts after every TID and returns an empty page.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Compares cursors lexically against spaceRev without TID validation, except that a cursor beginning with did: (the form Swan's pre-atproto#5574 writer listing returned) lists from the start of the space, since it cannot name a space revision. An empty cursor is treated as absent.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: The receiver accepts a repo-host notification when the service JWT iss equals body.repo and aud is the bare authority DID or <authority>#atproto_pds; the token carries no req body-digest claim and no jti replay record is kept. A repoRev equal to or older than the recorded one is ignored whatever its data. Repo updates sent to registered syncers are best effort.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: By default accepts only service JWTs whose req claim binds the request body, with iss equal to body.repo and aud the bare authority DID or <authority>#atproto_pds, and always sends req on notifications it signs. Unbound upstream-shaped tokens are accepted only under --enable-spaces-open-interop, with exp - iat <= 60 s and a durable single-use jti. An equal repoRev with different data is refused as equivocation; an older or identical one is ignored.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: The repo-host receiver accepts service auth whose iss is the space authority and whose aud is the DID of an account it hosts; the token carries no req body-digest claim and no jti replay record is kept. Revocations are retained for 3600 + 2 * 5 s from receipt.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: By default accepts only service JWTs whose req claim binds the request body (space and credential IDs), with iss equal to the space authority and aud a bare DID of an account Swan stores. Unbound upstream-shaped tokens are accepted only under --enable-spaces-open-interop, with exp - iat <= 60 s and a durable single-use jti. Revocations are retained for 3600 + 5 + 300 s from receipt, covering Swan's widest configurable credential expiry skew.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Issues space credentials with a 600 s default lifetime under the 3600 s ceiling.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Swan's simple-space authority issues 300 s credentials. An enabled conversation policy runtime uses 60 s credentials. Minting and verification enforce the same 3600 s ceiling, finite iat/exp, exp after iat, a required jti, and at most 5 s of future iat.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Lists the memberspace member list; the authority is not a member entry.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Also lists the authority itself as a read/write member, as Swan's member list has always done. The authority's entry is never published as a com.atproto.memberspace.member record.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: A managedspace asks its managing app through checkAccess, resolving the required managingApp service reference through its DID document.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Same, when serve is configured with a service endpoint resolver and the outbound transport; without them every non-authority access check fails with UpstreamFailure.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: POST /:did ends in Express res.sendStatus(200), producing status 200, Content-Type text/plain; charset=utf-8, and the two ASCII bytes OK.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Only explicit laboratory policy did-plc-server-0.0.1 accepts that exact no-redirect response at the requested URL; production and all PLC JSON reads retain strict validation.

compatibilityExceptions.referenceBehavior: An old since cursor is filtered with rev > since and returns HTTP 200; the live handler does not emit full_repo_recovery_required for a retention gap.
compatibilityExceptions.swanBehavior: Emits HTTP 409 full_repo_recovery_required when its retained range is exceeded. The recovery CLI remains strict by default and exposes an explicit --allow-full-car-fallback only for qualified reference-host full-STAR testing; fallback artifacts are excluded from retention-gap validation.

retiredCompatibilityExceptions.retiredBecause: Fixed upstream: the listRepoOps reader qualifies every space selector and joins record values on uri and cid, so value-bearing pages no longer fail. Swan's behavior is conformant, not an exception.
